newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy basis mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy basis mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis offers remained mostly steady on Monday amid limited farm sales and quiet export activity, dealers said.
Dealers cited very little farm sales as farmers focused their efforts on corn plantings in several areas of the Midwest.
"If there is movement, it is nothing to affect the market, a exporter said. "Farmers were planting mainly corn now."
On the export front, El Salvador was retendering for about 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes U.S. soybean meal in bulk under the PL-480 export program, its U.S. export agent said.
Taiwan is also expected to tender for 54,000 tonnes of soybeans this week while demand for corn will remain sluggish following the outbreak in March of hog foot-and-month disease, traders said.
